_comment: Model view rule. ETR = (target - price) / price + expected DPS / price. Undervalued if ETR > CoE + buy_margin; Overvalued if ETR < CoE - sell_margin; otherwise Fairly valued. BUY/HOLD/SELL labels are only shown when the SHOW_TRADE_LABELS setting is on (default off, PRODUCT_CONTEXT.md section 71).
